quantization: Estimated 4-bit weight-only; ideal size uses params × 0.5 bytes, with no pruning or disk streaming.
notes: Official Qwen card: 27B language-model parameters; native context 262,144, extendable to 1M. Memory is a planning estimate: required_memory_gib adds 20–25% for quantization metadata/runtime plus 16–48 GiB for one 108K session KV cache, OS and safety headroom; no qualifying single-node end-to-end measurement was found. The 51B n-gram lookup table sometimes discussed with the Qwen3.8 family belongs to the distinct Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model (Qwen paper reports 125B MoE + 51B embeddings), not this 27B checkpoint.
